```artifact
Feature: Patient Management System

  As a healthcare professional, I want to manage patient details and appointments effectively.

  So that I can ensure patient care is accurate and timely.

Scenario: Query and modify patient details
  Given a valid patient ID
  When I query the patient details
  Then the details should be displayed correctly
  And I should be able to modify the details except the patient pin-code

  Examples:
    | Patient ID | Pin-code | Speciality | Symptoms | Appointment Date |
    | 12345      | 1234     | Cardiology | Chest Pain | 2023-04-01     |
    | 67890      | 6789     | Neurology  | Headache   | 2023-04-02     |

Scenario: Create an appointment entry
  Given a valid patient ID and next day's date
  When I enter an appointment request
  Then an entry should be created in the Patient Appointment file
  And the details should be displayed correctly

  Examples:
    | Patient ID | Speciality | Symptoms | Appointment Date |
    | 12345      | Cardiology | Chest Pain | 2023-04-01     |
    | 67890      | Neurology  | Headache   | 2023-04-02     |

Scenario: Consultation workflow
  Given a valid patient ID
  When a consultation request is made
  Then the doctor should see the request
  And the doctor should be able to provide consultation

  Examples:
    | Patient ID | Speciality | Symptoms |
    | 12345      | Cardiology | Chest Pain |
    | 67890      | Neurology  | Headache   |

Scenario: Diagnosis and prescription workflow
  Given a valid patient ID and a consultation request
  When the doctor provides a diagnosis
  Then the prescription should be limited to 8 medicines
  And lab tests should be limited to 5

  Examples:
    | Patient ID | Speciality | Symptoms |
    | 12345      | Cardiology | Chest Pain |
    | 67890      | Neurology  | Headache   |

Scenario: Medicines provision workflow
  Given a valid patient ID and a prescription
  When the chemist sees the prescription
  Then the chemist should provide medicines
  And the prescription should be marked

  Examples:
    | Patient ID | Speciality | Symptoms |
    | 12345      | Cardiology | Chest Pain |
    | 67890      | Neurology  | Headache   |

Scenario: Lab requests workflow
  Given a valid patient ID and a prescription
  When the lab sees the prescription
  Then the lab should note the lab tests
  And the prescription should be marked

  Examples:
    | Patient ID | Speciality | Symptoms |
    | 12345      | Cardiology | Chest Pain |
    | 67890      | Neurology  | Headache   |
